what_this_is: The natal test. The earlier backtest tested transits in isolation and found nothing — but that was never the whole tradition, and 'astrology doesn't work on PSX' was an overclaim on that evidence. This tests what Vedic prediction actually rests on: Sade Sati, dashas, and transits to a real birth chart, using the 29 charts sourced from PSX's own listing records.
power_warning: 28 charts, most listed after 2010. Sade Sati runs 7.5 years in 29.5, so a young company contributes one partial window or none. A null here is WEAK evidence — it may mean 'no effect' or merely 'not enough history to see one'. Window counts are published beside every result so you can judge which. Absence of proof is not proof of absence.

method.returns: market-adjusted (r_stock - beta*r_market): raw returns measure beta, not astrology
method.test: circular-shift permutation; Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg both reported
method.min_window: 60 trading days — smaller windows are reported as untestable, not tested

headline.verdict: No natal claim survives correction either. Sade Sati, dashas and transits-to-natal were tested on 27 real birth charts and none beats chance. BUT the honest caveat stands: with charts this young the test is weakly powered, so this is 'not demonstrated', NOT 'disproved' — a distinction the desk keeps making because it is the difference between honesty and a verdict we haven't earned.
